changes.title: Stripe's current API version is 2026-10-28.endive; integrations pinned to an earlier major (Dahlia or older) need code changes to move to Endive.
2026-09-30.endive removes the payment_method_types parameter when creating Checkout Sessions.

source.quote: Removes the payment method types parameter from Checkout Sessions

changes.title: 2026-09-30.endive removes the writable payment_method_types parameter from Payment Intents and Setup Intents.

source.quote: Removes the payment method types parameter from Payment Intents and Setup Intents

changes.title: 2026-09-30.endive renames filters.countries to filters.country when creating Financial Connections Sessions.

source.quote: Renames the countries filter to country on Financial Connections Sessions

changes.title: 2026-09-30.endive removes the configurations parameter from the Account Links v2 API.

source.quote: Removes the configurations parameter from the Account Links v2 API

changes.title: Endive deprecates the Stripe.js payment request button element (front-end Elements code, not the server SDK).
stripe-node 23.0.0 pins 2026-09-30.endive and drops Node.js 18; Node.js 20 is the minimum.

source.quote: Drop support for Node.js 18. Node.js 20 is now the minimum supported version.

changes.title: stripe-node 23.0.0 now enforces the default timestamp tolerance in webhook signature checks when tolerance is omitted, and tolerance 0 now skips the check.

source.quote: `stripe.webhooks.signature.verifyHeader()` and `verifyHeaderAsync()` previously skipped timestamp tolerance verification when the `tolerance` argument was omitted. They now default to `Webhook.DEFAULT_TOLERANCE`
